lesson: Lebanon received 98 percent because it was the obvious sovereign actor responsible for Hezbollah, but Trump named adjacent Syria instead. Questions asking whom a political speaker will suggest are rhetorical-choice forecasts, not ordinary jurisdiction forecasts: cap even seemingly obvious principals and retain meaningful mass on adjacent security actors that fit the speaker's framing.

The forecast concentrated on Kashmir and regional protest leaders and omitted the nationally prominent PPP leader who announced the meeting. For unrest consultations with a prime minister, candidate generation must cover federal coalition principals and major party leaders as well as local officeholders.

Starmer was included at 23.5 percent but departmental-minister reasoning placed Liz Kendall at 75 percent. Major cross-government policies are often announced by the prime minister even when a specialist minister owns the portfolio, so principal-speaker base rates should outrank administrative ownership unless the announcement venue is clearly departmental.
